description_en: Creates an office network (formerly workspace) based on an enterprise Active Directory (AD) account system. Elastic Desktop Service supports convenient accounts and enterprise AD accounts
description_zh: 无影云电脑支持便捷账号和企业AD账号这两种账号体系。本接口用于创建一个基于企业AD账号的办公网络（原工作区）
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-ad-connector-office-site --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --dns-address 192.168.XX.XX --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateADConnectorOfficeSite

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The IPv4 CIDR block of the office network VPC. The system uses automatic creation to provision a VPC based on the specified IPv4 CIDR block. Use one of the following CIDR blocks or their subnets as the IPv4 CIDR block:

`10.0.0.0/12` (valid mask range: 12 to 24 bits)
`172.16.0.0/12` (valid mask range: 12 to 24 bits)
`192.168.0.0/16` (valid mask range: 16 to 24 bits)
parameters.help_zh:
办公网络VPC包含的IPv4网段。系统将根据输入的IPv4网段，自动创建一个专有网络VPC。建议您使用以下网段及其子网作为IPv4网段：

`10.0.0.0/12`（掩码有效范围为12\~24位）
`172.16.0.0/12`（掩码有效范围为12\~24位）
`192.168.0.0/16`（掩码有效范围为16\~24位）
parameters.name: cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance owner.

If CenId is not specified, or the specified CenId belongs to the current Alibaba Cloud account, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If the specified CenId belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, specify the Alibaba Cloud account ID of that account
parameters.help_zh:
云企业网实例所属的阿里云账号ID。

如果未配置CenId，或者配置的CenId属于本阿里云账号，该参数无需配置。
如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，请填写所属阿里云账号的ID
parameters.name: cen_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
parameters.help_zh: 云企业网实例ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The verification code. If the specified CenId belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, you must first call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436847.html to obtain the verification code
parameters.help_zh: 验证码。如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，必须先调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436847.html获取验证码
parameters.name: verify_code

parameters.help_en:
The peak Internet bandwidth, in Mbit/s. Valid values: 0 to 200.    
If you do not set this parameter or set it to 0, the Internet access feature is not enabled. Settings take effect immediately
parameters.help_zh:
公网带宽峰值。取值范围：0~200。    
不设置该参数或者设置为0表示不开通互联网访问功能
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the enterprise AD. The same domain name can be registered only once
parameters.help_zh: 企业AD的域名。相同的域名只能注册一次
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The username of the domain administrator. The username can be up to 64 characters in length.

Use the sAMAccountName format for the username. Do not use the userPrincipalName format
parameters.help_zh:
域管理员的用户名。最长支持64个英文字符。

用户名请使用sAMAccountName，不能使用userPrincipalName
parameters.name: domain_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the domain administrator. The password can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 域管理员的用户密码。最长支持64个英文字符
parameters.name: domain_password

parameters.help_en:
The name of the office network. The name must be 2 to 255 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter or Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.    
Default value: null
parameters.help_zh:
办公网络名称。长度为2~255个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。    
默认值：空
parameters.name: office_site_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to grant local administrator permissions to users who use cloud computers
parameters.help_zh: 是否为使用云电脑的用户赋予本地管理员权限
parameters.name: enable_admin_access

parameters.help_en:
The access method allowed when connecting to cloud computers.

The VPC connection method depends on the Alibaba Cloud PrivateLink service, which is free of charge. If this parameter is set to `VPC` or `Any`, the system automatically activates the PrivateLink service for you
parameters.help_zh:
连接云电脑时允许使用的接入方式。

VPC连接方式依赖于阿里云私网连接PrivateLink服务，该服务不收取费用。该参数设置为`VPC`或者`Any`时，系统将自动为您开通私网连接服务
parameters.name: desktop_access_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether public network access is enabled. This parameter indicates whether the feature is active
parameters.help_zh: 是否开通公网访问功能
parameters.name: enable_internet_access

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the enterprise AD subdomain
parameters.help_zh: 企业AD子域的域名
parameters.name: sub_domain_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable multi-factor authentication (MFA)
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启多因素认证MFA
parameters.name: mfa_enabled

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the DNS server corresponding to the enterprise AD. Currently, only one IP address is supported
parameters.help_zh: 企业AD对应DNS的IP地址。目前仅支持设置一个
parameters.name: dns_address

parameters.help_en: The DNS address of the enterprise AD subdomain. If `SubDomainName` is specified but this parameter is not, the subdomain DNS is considered the same as the parent domain DNS
parameters.help_zh: 企业AD子域的DNS地址。如果设置了`SubDomainName`，而未设置此参数，则认为子域DNS和父域一致
parameters.name: sub_domain_dns_address

parameters.help_en: The AD Connector specification
parameters.help_zh: AD Connector规格
parameters.name: specification

parameters.help_en: The hostname of the domain controller. The hostname must comply with Windows hostname naming conventions
parameters.help_zh:
域控主机名。
必须符合Windows主机命名规范
parameters.name: ad_hostname

parameters.help_en: The protocol type
parameters.help_zh: 协议类型
parameters.name: protocol_type

parameters.help_en: The DNS address of the backup domain controller
parameters.help_zh: 备用域控DNS地址
parameters.name: backup_dns

parameters.help_en: The hostname of the backup domain controller
parameters.help_zh: 备用域控主机名
parameters.name: backup_dc_hostname

parameters.help_en: The list of vSwitch IDs
parameters.help_zh: 交换机ID列表
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The access attribute of the office network (workspace)
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络（工作区）的访问属性
parameters.name: access_attribute
